about.description: BRKB is a single-stock perpetual listed on BingX, tracking Berkshire Hathaway Inc. Class B, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
